Nina: opened a small docs PR to unify streaming+pagination snippets across py/ts/go. highlights: explicit retries, backpressure hint, and a short migration note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999 :memo:
DocsBot: PR #4999 created by Nina  running snippet-checker + md-lint.
Omar: quick skim  love the polyglot layout. two requests: (1) show resume semantics with a cursor sample, (2) mention that streaming can rely on model KV cache so resuming may be different.
Nina: plan: add a tiny resume example and a "gotchas" callout about KV cache. I'll draft a python resume snippet.
Rae: nit: keep fenced blocks with language tag (```python / ```ts / ```go) so highlight works. Also prefer page_size=32 to match other docs.
Nina: python resume sketch:
```python
async def stream_resume(client, cursor=None):
    while True:
        resp = await retry_with_backoff(lambda: client.get_page(cursor=cursor, page_size=32))
        async for chunk in resp.stream():
            process(chunk)
            await asyncio.sleep(0)  # yield to event loop for backpressure
        if not resp.next_cursor:
            break
        cursor = resp.next_cursor
```
Omar: looks good. For TS, show `for await (const page of client.stream_pages(...))` and wrap page fetch with retryWithBackoff. For Go, make sure to show proper response close and error handling.
CI-Bot: snippet-checker: python missing retry wrapper in one file; ts uses "chunks" but current SDK returns "items". Failing files: examples/streaming.md line 78.
Nina: pushing fixes now: switch chunks->items in TS, add retry helper to python, add defer resp.Body.Close() in Go, and a short migration blurb at the top explaining streamPages -> stream_pages and items vs chunks. Will tag reviewers after CI passes.
Rae: thanks. once CI passes, can we collapse the three samples into a single expandable 'Examples' block on the page? keeps the main text short.
Nina: yes, will do that and file a follow-up to add a tiny comparison table (resume / kv-cache / retry behavior). merging after green. :rocket:
